title: Q-LITE-webmention-wire: serve the /webmention receiver that site/lite.js defines
body:
**Owner:** marketing-manager
**Trigger:** ULTRASTABLE-LITE-1 (#2566) merged a receiver nothing mounts, and its closing probe reads `site/worker.js`
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q webmention -- site/worker.js
**Status:** closed

`site/lite.js` defines `POST /webmention` but `site/worker.js` never imports it, and the file does not parse as an ES module (`await` inside a function that is not `async`). Make the handler `async`, mount it for `POST /webmention` in the site router, add a test that sends a valid and an invalid mention through the router, and bring `docs/handoff/site-lite-webmention.md` up to date or remove it when the route is served.

**Prediction:** external_referrals_7d > 83 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** other site routes; the `site_data` schema; any change to what a mention must contain.

size: S

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q webmention -- site/worker.js exits 0 on main. It exits 1 today: the router does not mention it.


**Evidence:** closed by the pull request that carries this change
